messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — opened PR to sync new limit fields and add SDK examples for orion and zephyr variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Maya Patel: thanks — link broken in model table for zephyr-mini-4b, saw 404. I can fix after review.
Samir (eng): I left comments about the supported-quant flag; runtime needs `quantized_compat: true` in model-card to route to cpu fallback.
Carla (docs): Can we add a minimal runnable snippet for Python SDK showing `client.generate(..., model="orion-7b")` and the streaming handler? That's where users get tripped up.
Alex Chen: yes — included a short snippet in the PR, but it's failing md lint on the fenced code indentation. Snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
for chunk in c.generate_stream("orion-7b", prompt="Summarize..."):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Maya Patel: Also need to update limits table: max_input_tokens -> 8192 for orion-7b in the catalog. Benchmarks might need re-run for long-seq.
Samir (eng): I'll run a quick throughput bench and paste results — give me 30m. If numbers change, we should gate with a note: "bench measured on p4d-based dedicated cluster".
docs-bot: Lint check passed on markdown, but link-checker found one dead link: /models/zephyr-mini-4b -> 404
Carla (docs): @Maya can you push link fix? @Samir add bench outputs as a CSV in `docs/data/benchmarks` and reference it.
Maya Patel: pushed link fix in a followup commit.
Samir (eng): Bench done — attached snippet of throughput: `orion-7b, seq_len=1024, batch=8 -> 150 tok/s` ; `orion-7b-quant, seq_len=1024, batch=8 -> 320 tok/s`.
Alex Chen: great. Let's also add a compatibility note about kv-cache invalidation when using quantized variants — small behavioral change.
Carla (docs): wording suggestion: "Note: quantized variants may produce different cached generation boundaries due to precision differences; validate via your prompt suite." 
Maya Patel: One more ask — update SDK example to include `wait_for_stream=True` param mention and a short test snippet for pytest. Example:
```python
def test_orion_generation_smoke(redwood_client):
    out = redwood_client.generate("orion-7b", prompt="Hello")
    assert "Hello" in out.text
```
Alex Chen: Can someone approve the PR? I'm out at 4pm PT. @Carla? 
Carla (docs): I'll do a quick pass and merge after adding a changelog entry. 
Carla (docs): Merge done. Deployed to staging — tagging @qa for smoke.
QA-Bot: Staging smoke tests passed for docs rendering (no broken code fences), but discovered one embed image 404 in /docs/models/orion-7b.
Maya Patel: I'll upload the missing image asset now.
Samir (eng): Follow-up action: open issue to add unit tests for snippet rendering in CI — creating #issue-642
Alex Chen: thanks everyone :rocket:
